title: A level is not a rank: an empirical audit of quantile-to-index conversion in 10 released conformal-prediction libraries
abstract: arXiv:2611.23329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context. A conformal interval at 0.90 keeps that guarantee only at the right rank: a fresh score falls at or below the rth smallest of n with probability r/(n + 1). The libraries we study instead hand a level to a quantile function, which can land elsewhere. At n = 20, the upper end of statsforecast's interval sits at position 18.05 where rank 19 is required. Objective. Where does installed code resolve the wrong rank, at what cost in coverage, and what does it return when no rank reaches the level? Method. We audit 39 sites where a level becomes an index in 10 pinned packages, a named set rather than a systematic search. 12 are classified by running them, 11 through their shared numpy method, the rest from source. Coverage is paired against the required rank on the same scores. Results. All 7 tabular implementations reach the required rank. In darts, on one code path, coverage is unchanged (0.0000) where the ranks agree and 0.0280 to 0.

translated_title: 水平不是秩：对10个已发布共形预测库中分位数到索引转换的实证审计
translated_abstract: 背景。0.90水平的共形区间只有在正确的秩处才能保持其保证：一个新分数以概率r/(n+1)落在n个分数中第r小者或以下。我们所研究的库却将置信水平传递给分位数函数，这可能落在其他位置。当n=20时，statsforecast区间的上端位于第18.05个位置，而秩19才是所要求的。目标。已安装的代码在哪里解析出错误的秩，覆盖率上的代价是多少，以及当没有秩能达到该水平时它返回什么？方法。我们审计了10个固定版本软件包中共39处将水平转换为索引的代码位置，这是一个指定名称的集合而非系统性搜索。其中12处通过实际运行来分类，11处通过它们共享的numpy方法分类，其余通过源代码分类。覆盖率在相同的分数上与所要求的秩进行配对比较。结果。所有7个表格实现都达到了所要求的秩。在darts中，在一条代码路径上，当秩一致时覆盖率不变（0.0000），而0.0280到0.[原文摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 该论文对10个已发布的共形预测库中39处“置信水平转换为索引”的代码位置进行了实证审计，发现部分库将置信水平错误地解析为分位数秩，在特定样本量下导致实际覆盖率偏离理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically audits 39 level-to-index conversion sites across 10 released conformal-prediction libraries, showing that some libraries resolve the wrong quantile rank for a given coverage level, causing actual coverage to deviate from the theoretical guarantee at certain sample sizes.
